debate.key_bear_argument: Fundamental structural weakness—price below all major moving averages (9/21/50/200 EMA/SMA), bearish MACD, negative money flow (CMF), three black crows pattern, thick Ichimoku resistance, weak ADX trend strength, and severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, earnings risk in 60 days)—overwhelm minor technical recovery signals.
